body.name: Three-coordinate rational graph gadget
body.construction: Index coordinates by \((u_i,v_i,w_i)\) for \(i\in[n]\). Set \(B_G[\{u_i,v_i,w_i\},\{u_i,v_i,w_i\}]=\begin{pmatrix}0&1&1\\ p&0&0\\ r&0&0\end{pmatrix}\), set \((B_G)_{u_i u_j}=g(A_G)_{ij}\), set all other cross-block entries to zero, and set \(W_G=I_{3n}-B_G\).
